# Unit

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Measurement units for lengths and dimensions. Following PDF specification, points (1/72 inch) are the default unit.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Point`: Points - 1/72 inch (PDF default)
- `Inch`: Inches - 72 points
- `Centimeter`: Centimeters - 28.35 points
- `Millimeter`: Millimeters - 2.835 points
